facts.fact: The fees are in the First Schedule of the Trade Marks Rules, 2017; Entry 1 is the application for registration of a trade mark (Form TM-A), with separate physical-filing and e-filing fees
facts.quote: First Schedule: Trade Mark Rules 2017 Entry No On what payable For Physical filing For E-filing Corresponding Form Number 1 Application for registration of a trademark

facts.fact: Where the applicant is an Individual/Startup/Small Enterprise the TM-A fee is Rs 4,500 for e-filing and Rs 5,000 for physical filing
facts.quote: Where the applicant is an Individual / Startup/Small Enterprise 5,000 4,500 In all other cases

facts.fact: In all other cases the TM-A fee is Rs 9,000 (e-filing) / Rs 10,000 (physical), and the fee is for each class and each mark
facts.quote: In all other cases (Note: Fee is for each class and for each mark ) 10,000 9,000

facts.fact: Expedited examination under rule 34 costs Rs 20,000 per class per mark for an Individual/Startup/Small Enterprise and Rs 40,000 for others, e-filing only (not allowed on paper)
facts.quote: On application under rule 34 for expedited process of an application for the registration of a trademark Where the applicant is an Individual / Startup/Small Enterprise Not allowed 20,000 In all other cases (Note: fee is for each class and for each mark) Not allowed 40,000

facts.fact: A notice of opposition or counter-statement costs Rs 2,700 per class by e-filing (Rs 3,000 physical)
facts.quote: (Note: Fee is for each class opposed or counterstatement filed) 3,000 2,700

facts.fact: Renewal of registration costs Rs 9,000 per class by e-filing (Rs 10,000 physical)
facts.quote: For renewal of registration of a trademark under section 25 for each class 10,000 9,000

facts.fact: A registered trade mark is valid for 10 years and is renewed for further periods of 10 years
facts.quote: A registered trade mark is valid for 10 years from the date of application Registration may be renewed indefinitely for further periods of 10 years

summary: All TM-A, expedited, opposition and renewal fees confirmed on the IP India Forms & Official Fees page (First Schedule, TM Rules 2017); 10-year term confirmed on the IP India basics page.
